traditions.auth: Hand-knit pieces show irregular tension; islands provenance; cream undyed wool

traditions.r: Channel Islands and British fishing coasts
traditions.d: Seaman's jumper knitting from Guernsey, spread to Cornish, Yorkshire and Scottish fishing villages with local patterns.
traditions.tech: Tight knitting in the round, underarm gusset, split welt, village-specific textured patterns
traditions.auth: Diamond underarm gusset, shoulder strap and rope-ladder ribbing; hand-finishing on Guernsey

traditions.d: Stranded colourwork using two colours per row in a limited palette, made fashionable in 1921.
traditions.tech: Stranded knitting in the round, short floats, OXO and star bands
traditions.auth: Only two colours per round, Shetland wool, traditional motif bands; 'Fair Isle' properly means Shetland patterns, not any stranded knit

traditions.d: Yoke-patterned sweaters in unspun lopi wool that became a national symbol after 1944 independence.
traditions.tech: Seamless circular knitting, patterned yoke shaped by decreases
traditions.auth: Icelandic wool, hand-knit in Iceland; unspun lopi yarn with airy hand

traditions.d: Regional patterned sweaters and mittens (lusekofte, fanakofte, selburose) and their 20th-century descendants.
traditions.tech: Two-colour stranded knitting; lice stitches; embroidered bands and pewter clasps
traditions.auth: Norwegian wool, clasps and embroidered facings on Setesdal pieces; Dale and Rauma labels

traditions.d: Coast Salish hand-knitting of heavy shawl-collar sweaters in undyed wool with pictorial motifs.
traditions.tech: Hand-spun bulky single-ply, hand-knit, motifs worked in natural shades
traditions.mat: Undyed white, grey and brown wool
traditions.auth: Hand-spun undyed wool, knitted by Coast Salish knitters; Cowichan Tribes trademark; imitations (Mary Maxim, Pendleton, HBC) are 'Cowichan-style'

notes: Sweater split: Aran, Guernsey, Fair Isle, Lopapeysa, Norwegian (Setesdal/Marius/Cortina/Fana) and Cowichan are now their own kinds with tradition entries; old sweater models (Aran Sweater Market, Jamieson's, Le Tricoteur, Rauma, We Norwegians, Dale) moved into those kinds as versions or m. Dropped: POTRENDS models/range (wholesale noise), Kaidarova Set Qudalyk (not a cardigan), 2 of 4 Aran Sweater Market SKUs, Glenmuir g.Coll/g.George (SKU trim), Barbour list cut from 14 to 2, Aubin from 5 to 1. Guðrun & Guðrun Vón kept in Sweater m because the retrieved page describes it as Faroese, not Icelandic lopapeysa. Cricket sweater, rollneck, shawl collar are types not kinds. Ralph Lauren Flag sweater sourced from Macy's product page (ralphlauren.com blocked by captcha); its launch year and the Shaggy Dog launch year were not confirmed on retrieved pages, so eras are left vague. John Smedley model names (Dorset, Bobby) not confirmed, so archetype has no versions; johnsmedley.com was not accessible. Kanata/Inverallan/Le Tricoteur/Rauma founding years not on retrieved pages. Granted closed in 2025 per retrieved news page. Cowichan sweater kept maker-free; makers of imitations sit under the Cardigan archetype. Sweater vest stays tier with Lands' End only (no independent test winners retrieved).
